about: Speaking in five (22 Nov 2026): the Writing 'in five' ladder for a Speaking Part. Five moves, one sentence each, the school's frames first (data/drills/speaking/*.json). {X} = what the pupil picks or types. 'q' on a subject is the examiner's question ({X} filled). 'secs' is the target length of the whole answer said aloud.
name: Part 3
how: Part 3 in five: start the discussion, invite your partner in, react, move on, then decide together. It's a conversation, not two speeches.

nameAsk.title: Which one will you talk about?
nameAsk.aim: Pick one of the ideas on the examiner's card. You'll start with it.

subjects.label: Technology
subjects.q: How useful are these things for teenagers?

subjects.label: Family
subjects.q: How enjoyable are these ways of spending time with your family?

subjects.label: Your town
subjects.q: How could these things make a town better for young people?

subjects.label: School
subjects.q: How important are these things for a good school?

slots.label: Start it
slots.job: start the discussion with one idea

ways.t: Shall we start with {X}? I think it's really useful, because …

slots.label: Ask your partner
slots.q: Which one invites your partner in?

ways.t: What do you think? Do you agree?
What's your opinion on this one?

slots.label: React
slots.job: react to what your partner just said
slots.q: Which one reacts to your partner?

ways.t: I see what you mean, but …

slots.label: Move on
slots.job: move the discussion to the next idea
slots.q: Which one moves the discussion on?

ways.t: Shall we move on to the next one?
What about this one over here?
OK, let's talk about something else.

slots.label: Decide
slots.q: Which one helps you decide together?
